Noah Kahan Adds Extra 2027 Shows in London and Dublin - Here’s All The Access Info You Need

By Maxim Mower

September 1, 2026 4:18 pm GMT

Link copied
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:13
Instaread

Noah Kahan has added a third show at London's Wembley Stadium and a second at Dublin's Aviva Stadium, due to immense demand for the ‘Orbiter’ hitmaker's 2027 run.

Kahan will now play an extra date in Dublin on July 18th, 2027, while he'll headline a third night at Wembley Stadium on July 25th, 2027. Crucially, there is no planned Artist Pre-Sale for these new dates, with General On-Sale staring on Wednesday, September 2nd at 10am local time. You just need to click onto Ticketmaster in order to have access to tickets, and organisers advise ensuring you're logged in ahead of time with your payment card to hand so as to streamline the process.

Initially, Kahan was only due to headline one show at Wembley Stadium, Aviva Stadium and Glasgow's Hampden Park, with the Vermont native adding more due to the fan response.

At the time of writing, the ‘Stick Season’ singer-songwriter has just the one show on the books in Glasgow, but we wouldn't be surprised if he adds another in the coming days.

It looks like fans on the other side of The Pond will be able to see Kahan in action next summer, too, with the folk titan teasing a 2027 North America tour during his show last night (August 21st). Kahan hinted that an announcement was on the horizon.

It shouldn't be surprising that there is such high demand for Kahan's 2027 World Tour shows in London, Dublin and Glasgow, with the ‘Orange Juice’ crooner continuing to cement himself as one of the most influential figures in modern folk music.

His latest album, The Great Divide: The Last Of The Bugs, showcased Kahan's ability to go beyond his contemporaries in terms of soul-searching vulnerability and soaring melodies, with many critics and commentators - including this one - hailing that project as even better than his break-out opus, Stick Season: We'll All Be Here Forever.

We can't wait to see Kahan take the stage next summer, and those lucky enough to get their hands on tickets to his Autumn 2026 shows across the Atlantic will be looking forward to getting a sneak preview of what to expect at his stadium shows next year.

For the full list of UK and Ireland shows on Noah Kahan's 2027 The Great Divide Tour so far, with ticket links, see below:

July 13th - Glasgow, Scotland - Hampden Park

July 17th - Dublin, Ireland - Aviva Stadium

*NEW* July 18th - Dublin, Ireland - Aviva Stadium

July 23rd - London, UK - Wembley Stadium

July 24th - London, UK - Wembley Stadium

*NEW* July 25th - London, UK - Wembley Stadium
